summary: Specified documented reliance and burden thresholds so midstream route changes can be judged by ordinary evidence and learner-facing burden rather than by vague fairness rhetoric or all-or-nothing settled-credit rules.
why_this_counted: closed the archive's live gap about what counts as documented reliance and when added burden becomes large enough to change the owed response
turned in-flight protection into a two-part operating rule by adding evidence bands (`E0`-`E4`) and burden bands (`B0`-`B3`)
made the archive explicit that stronger midstream protection is triggered by ordinary advising/submission/payment/progress traces plus material delay, repeat, or non-trivial direct cost
narrowed the next live problem to who should absorb bridge, reassessment, and support costs when a system-caused rule change still requires extra steps
